about: Misthalin piece 7 step 7: Silvarea, the valley between Varrock's east fence and the Salve (Silvarea.kt). Its thirteen bats and the Odd Old Man by his pot-boiler, on the tiles mejrs's list saw them. Elias White isn't here: the Wiki puts him at the Jolly Boar Inn or Uzer once his quests are done.
